name: Bern

items.label: Taxable income (Bern)
items.note: Net salary less the professional costs lump sum, the CHF 2,450 insurance premiums deduction, the CHF 5,300 general deduction and CHF 2,400 for someone living alone in their own household.

items.label: Simple tax (Bern)
items.note: Bern's 2026 tariff for single people: 1.95% on the first CHF 3,300, rising in steps to 6.5% on income above CHF 470,600.

items.label: Cantonal and city tax (Bern)
items.note: The simple tax times the 2026 multipliers: 2.975 for the canton and 1.54 for the city of Bern (4.515 in all). No church tax.

notModelled: Pillar 3a contributions and other personal deductions
The deduction for small and middle incomes (up to CHF 1,100 for single people, phasing out above CHF 16,700)
provisional: Assumes a single person living alone in their own household (the CHF 2,400 deduction)
Bern taxable income is not rounded here

obtainedFrom.note: 2026 single tariff, general (5,300) and single-household (2,400) deductions, insurance deduction (2,450) and professional costs (3% of net salary, 2,000–4,000) from the ESTV Kantonsblatt; 2026 multipliers canton 2.975 and city of Bern 1.54 (total 4.515) from the Finanzverwaltung's table, Stand 1 February 2026.
